messages:
Ava (PM): Kicking off PRD intake for a customer pilot: per-route batching config UI. Need problem statement, goals, non-goals, success metrics, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. Can eng/design/cs fill by EOD Wed? Link WIP: https://docs.internal/redwood/prd/per-route-batching

Ben (Eng): Quick clarification: UI is an opinionated surface only, correct? Config store / API stays source of truth. UI writes to same store and is auditable.

Ava (PM): Correct. Draft problem statement: customers have coarse/global batching knobs. They want per-route controls to avoid broad tradeoffs (cost vs latency) that hurt other apps.

Cara (Design): For scope I suggest: routes table, profile editor modal, validation states, history/audit view, and a simple canary toggle for percent rollout. Will mock by Tue.

Edd (Customer Success): Pilot customer (Acme) wants: >=12% cost reduction on selected high-throughput routes and no regression in 95th latency. They also want exportable configs and an approval flow.

Deepak (Infra): Runtime has adaptive batching primitives but we need rollout primitives and write-time validation. Suggest adding schema fields: max_batch_size, target_p95_ms, min_inflight_per_tenant. Need guard rails to prevent configs that starve low-traffic routes.

Ben (Eng): Draft acceptance criteria (edit as needed):
- UI lists routes + effective batching profile
- Create/edit/delete profile persisted to config store with versioning
- Validation prevents absurd values (max_batch_size > 8192, negative latency) and surfaces warnings
- Canary rollout: apply to X% traffic with simple metric checks and manual rollback within 5m
- Audit trail records user/timestamp/diff and configs exportable as JSON
- E2E test proving no regression on 95th latency for a baseline route under controlled load

Ava (PM): Add success metrics: pilot onboard 3 customers in 6 weeks; Acme: >=12% cost reduction on targeted routes; platform: <5% incidence of 95th latency regressions across default routes during rollouts. Non-goal: we are not building autoscaling here.

Ben (Eng): Edge cases to capture: concurrent edits (optimistic locking + conflict UI), tenant isolation, applying config while model variant switches, extremely low-traffic routes (should be no-op), and a safety fallback that reverts to last-known-good within 60s on runtime errors.

triage-bot: created INF-8291 and linked to PRD stub https://tickets.internal/INF-8291

Ben (Eng): I'll own the RFC + perf microbenchmarks. Will put perf snippets under docs/perf/batching/. Will include runbook for pilot and specific perf tests (95th p95, cost tokens per 1M requests, microbench with various seq-lens).

Ava (PM): Please include acceptance criteria, perf test descriptions, and a short customer runbook. Scheduling 30m sync Thu 10am. Invite sent.

Cara (Design): Uploading initial mocks and an approval flow spec to the doc.

Edd (Customer Success): I'll prepare Acme test dataset and a short QA checklist for approvals.

Ben (Eng): RFC stub will be live today; will paste link here when ready.
